Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Kanaujia Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Dr. Shailendra Sharma,Shitesh Jha Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. Initially a missing person report was lodged, however, in the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone to Dehradoon with the applicant and married there with the applicant at a temple.
As per the medical record, the age of the victim is about 18-20 years.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 19.07.2021.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

entities.text: Masoom Ali Alias Hani Alias Lamboo S/O ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Considering the said two statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.
coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 19.07.2021 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Masoom Ali Alias Hani Alias Lamboo be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.
198 of 2021, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 344 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Nighasan, District Lakhimpur Kheri, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Arun  Masoom Ali Alias Hani Alias Lamboo S/O ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186164485/
